verification_recipe.github: git clone --depth 1 <url>; git fetch --depth 1 origin <commit>; git cat-file -t <commit> must print 'commit'; read LICENSE at that commit before reuse.
verification_recipe.arxiv_pdf: sha256sum the PDF and compare pdf_sha256; confirm title and arXiv id on page 1.
verification_recipe.vendor_pages: Open each URL in a browser; record date, page title, and any model version string; none are verified yet.
